_comment: Independent human-reader family labels for labeled_corpus.jsonl (AC-03, OQ-6). line_index is 0-based over JSONL lines. Only user/assistant TEXT blocks that a human reader judges to carry a family are listed as positives. Lines NOT listed are negatives: neutral chatter, doc-tidy noise, tool_use/tool_result/thinking (the parser drops the latter three). See PROVENANCE.md for independence mode (anchors-before-port). raw_bytes is the size of labeled_corpus.jsonl, used by the <=10% volume check.
